Title: Azure Search: Search Traffic Analytics available

Body.Content: Traffic analytics in Azure Search allow you to unlock insights about your users and applications. Service logs and operational metrics in Azure Search are copied to a separate Azure Storage account, and a Power BI content pack instantly transforms your raw search traffic data into a usable dashboard where you can customize reports and create visualizations. To read more about how to get started with this feature, see Analyzing your Azure Search traffic.
Body.Markdown:
Traffic analytics in Azure Search allow you to unlock insights about your users and applications. Service logs and operational metrics in Azure Search are copied to a separate Azure Storage account, and a Power BI content pack instantly transforms your raw search traffic data into a usable dashboard where you can customize reports and create visualizations.

To read more about how to get started with this feature, see Analyzing your Azure Search traffic .
